notes.content:
+ Placing the mouse cursor over the icon in the bottom left corner can reveal unit base stats.
+ Adjusted the difficulty of endless battles.
+ Added a new card that grants 500 experience points each time it's used.
+ Fixed some bugs.

+ Now you can construct Elven buildings and train Elven units for combat (unlocked through talent upgrades).
+ Added a new endless battle challenge.
+ Reduced the difficulty of the casual mode.
+ The price of Mana Potion cards has been reduced to 300 gold coins, increasing by 100 gold coins with each purchase, up to a maximum of 999 gold coins.
+ The coefficient for experience gained from killing monsters has been increased from 0.75 to 1.25.
After using the Magic Arrow skill, the Heavy Crossbow will no longer consume wood for the rest of the day.
+ Fixed the issue of duplicate card synthesis

+ Added a new resolution.
+ Fixed a bug that could cause the game to freeze.
+ Fixed an issue where the range of the hunter's hut was not increasing properly.

+ The Hunter Hut now allows for an expanded attack range after the upgrade.
+ Added skill shortcuts for easier access.
+ Constructing multiple blacksmith workshops can increase the refresh probability of crafting cards.
+ The Lucky Necklace now enhances the probability of crafting cards.
+ Fixed several bugs.

+ Fixed the issue where refreshing cards under specific conditions could potentially cause the game to freeze (requires testing).
+ Resolved the problem of the Seal of Treasures Book not functioning.
+ Fixed the issue of incorrect values for synthesized high-level equipment.
+ Addressed the problem of passive treasures not being able to upgrade properly.
+ Rectified the issue where running the game for an extended period would result in lag.

notes.title: version 1.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.0[/b]

Added 5 new races for casual battles
Introduced challenge modes for 7 races
Added passive treasures
Introduced a new card building: Black Market
Added two new elemental creatures
Included several new treasures
Introduced a new type of beer
Added Guard Training Camp, allowing control over the refresh of guard cards
Lucky Necklace now has a new effect, with a chance to prevent the consumption of wood for heavy crossbows
Adjusted the effect of Guardian Shield to 100%
Reduced the number of recruitable guards

Fixed an issue where wands couldn't merge properly
Fixed the ineffectiveness of Greedy Ring
Fixed an issue that could prevent the game from continuing
Fixed an incorrect population limit increase from Shabby Dwellings

[b]Demo Version: 0.3.1[/b]

Added a new angelic unit.
Now you can retract the last used building-type card.
Cards reaching the maximum limit no longer enter the refresh pool.
Added upgrades to increase the maximum capacity of the treasure backpack.
Adjusted the difficulty of all casual modes.
Artifact upgrade coefficient adjusted to 2.
The combat button shortcut key is set to the spacebar.
Skill shortcut keys are set to Q, W, E, R, and T.
Increased damage of the Hunter's Hut by 1.
Increased the number of fireballs in the Rain of Fire skill from 10 to 12.
Increased the effect of diplomatic cards from 1 to 2.
Some adjustments to details.

Fixed the issue with the Charm Ring being ineffective.

notes.title: 0.2.6 update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Demo Version: 0.2.6[/b][/h1]

Now you can seal some unnecessary cards that you don't want before each battle.
Resource icons now display the output from the previous day.
Talent upgrades can be reset now.
Clicking on the time in the upper right corner can end the current battle.
Low-level equipment now automatically upgrades to a higher level when merging.
You can now unseal sealed cards.
Increased the refresh probability of castle upgrade cards.
Game acceleration now has 6 modes.
Every 3 completed battles randomly reward a treasure.
Now the Goddess's blessing effect can be chosen from three options.
The price of sealing cards has been reduced to 50 gold.
Added new treasure: Greedy Ring, a chance that cards won't disappear when purchased.
Added new treasure: Charm Ring, a chance to purchase cards without spending gold.
Added new treasure: Pact, if the castle is not attacked on the same day, luxury residences will give a gold reward.
Added new treasure: Ceasefire Agreement, for the first X days of a battle, neither side will send troops to attack the other.
Added two new talent upgrades.
Added a third challenge.


Fixed an issue where trading cards would be refreshed when clicking other cards.
Fixed an issue where reserved cards could still refresh on the same day.
Fixed an issue where cards sometimes could not be unlocked normally.

[b][h1]Demo Version[/h1][/b]

Full-screen mode is now available.
You can now return to the main menu from the game.
Adjusted the size of UI text.
Added a player's treasure backpack, allowing free switching of owned treasures during battles.
Each race-specific treasure increased to two.
Added new challenge mode.
Added two challenges.
Added a signet feature; now new cards need to be unlocked from here.
Pressing the number keys 1, 2, 3 can quickly adjust the game speed now.
Adjusted the values of some equipment cards.
Added some new goddess blessings.
After the battle, you can see the newly unlocked cards.
Redesigned the treasure warehouse.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed an issue where soldier units would sometimes run out of the combat area.
Fixed an issue where the Next Day button would sometimes resend repeatedly.


[h1][b]Full Version Update:[/b][/h1]

Completed the battle map for the Orc race.
Completed the battle map for the Dwarf race.
Added the Fire Rain and Lightning Trap skills.
Added some new race-specific treasures.
Added a new building: Dwarf Brewery.
Added three new beer cards.
